title: Third Reich Berlin WalkingTour - Hitler and WWII
description: The Nazi surrender that ended the Second World War is still a point of interest for any visitor to Berlin, but matching locations to these poignant moments of history can be a challenge. Forget the guidebook and hear from a guide about Hitler’s dramatic last days in Berlin, and learn more about the daily life of those who lived, and resisted, under Nazi rule, while viewing some of the most significant historical sites in the city.

reviews.usertext:
I did the 3rd Reich Tour with my wife and 2 children (13 and 11). Our guide was Chloe who was also very knowledgeable and showed us a variety of sites including the Reichstag where she told us about the planned World Capital that Hitler had wanted to create. She then took us to the Soviet Memorial where she looked after the group extremely well when a man tried to gate-crash our tour and offer unwanted opinions on the Soviet role in the war and tried to drag our conversation into modern politics (he approached just about every group at the memorial).

We then moved on to the building where those involved in the Valkyrie plot were assassinated, the T4 memorial and finished up on the modern site of Hitler’s Bunker. There were no trains required for this tour.

A great way to get a condensed version of the history if you have limited time, Chloe was excellent.

Campbell was a fantastic guide, an Australian historian who's knowledge of Berlin, Hitler and the Third Reich was second to none. I actually downloaded a three day tour itinerary but decided to go with this great value for money tour - I'm so glad I did. There were lots of questions that were all answered and the locations visited were both fascinating and educational. 100% recommended, cracking three hours well spent.

We couldn't have had a better tour guide than Hannah. Not only was she incredibly knowledgeable, but she was passionate about the subject and gave an extraordinary and very detailed synopsis of the Third Reich, including the events leading up to it. She was upbeat, energetic, funny, encouraged our questions, and made the whole tour enjoyable, in spite of the gravity of the subject.

We were extremely disappointed in this tour. Firstly, it makes zero sense to meet at Friedrichstraße station if the first thing we do is take a metro to go four more stops — a long time was wasted with the guide helping those without tickets buy them etc. So, anyways, finally once we were all at the right station, the tour actually begins 30 mins later. It began at the Topography of Terror, which says will be the final stop. Sure, no problems changing the order BUT this didn’t make sense as he said “you can go in after the tour” but we finished the tour over 1.5km away - so wouldn’t it just make sense to finish the tour exactly there so we could enter? Anyways, another real disappointment was the bunker. There is a sign there showing the bunker layout and giving more info but again, he said “you can go see that after the tour” — but then we would have to walk all the way back? None of this made any sense. He also started talking about what happened with Hitler’s death but then said jokingly “But I don’t f*#^ing care” — not overly professional when we are paying for you to care! I would say 50% of the tour was focused on WWII and the rest was about the Cold War, tips about bars, going out, conversations about Berliners, and a lot of the guide’s opinions about what’s happening in the Ukraine. So, for us, this tour made ZERO sense as it did not match the title. Also, we had done the “Original Free Berlin Walking Tour” the day before and it went to 80% of the same places (and that guide was much better) so this was really a waste of money!! I would NOT recommend it.

We booked just one day before on a read review. All the major sites had been seen and a different view of berlin was what we saught. Nicolai was an informative interesting guide. His stories and tales of where we were standing and what actually permeated at the time was interesting. As he said himself there may have been information overload but you came away with a different insight. The city of Berlin is diverse, picturesque and seeped in a history that confronts and makes you sit up. We were even heckled on our talk at one stop but thats berlin it has many sides.i would definitely recommend this as the sites alone do not give a full picture of the 1920/30 without this insight.

Our tour guide, Jim, was excellent. He was hugely knowledgeable while taking the tour at a good pace that accommodated a range of interest within our group. The tour was accessible and highly recommended for those with a casual interest and indeed those with a more in-depth knowledge.

Nickolai was incredibly knowledgeable and on top of his game. His scholarship was evident from the begining to the end of the tour. However, the way the tour was constructed needs some work.
The emphasis was on the walking part and anyone who stopped to take pictures was quick to fall behind. Most visitors may not have been to Berlin before and taking photos of the Brandenburg Gate is pretty standard. We were told there would be time after the tour for photos but it doesn't make sense to say that when the tour ends elsewhere.
A lot of the points of interest were at busy squares or on the street. The guide should have been miked up for this. One of the members of our party has hearing difficulty and could not hear a lot of what was said unless he was right by the guide.
This tour was 3.5 hours. There needs to be an intermission built in for restroom and a water break. The guide seemed annoyed when half the tour needed to use the facilities and he had to halt the tour. Otherwise you got left behind and were magically expected to guess which direction to go to catch up with the tour.

Jim was a great guide. Passionate and very knowledgeable about key events covering 1933 to 1945. This is a great tour for anyone interested in learning about the Nazis. A visit to the Topography Of Terror museum where the tour ends is highly recommended.

Nikolai was an amazing tour guide. I would highly recommend him to anyone who visits the city and takes the Third Reich Tour. You could feel how passionate he was about the Third Reich and all of the events that lead up to the events of WWll. He was always more than willing to answer any questions that anyone might of had as well as answer any questions regarding other historical events that took place in Berlin. I also appreciate that on a rainy day in Berlin he took us on the city transportation to get around to each site. I can’t praise his tour enough and would take it again!

Chloe was an absolutely excellent guide.
She offered a wealth of factual information but also brought events to life with some personal stories and anecdotes.
She delivered the material in a wholly appropriate manner - somber when necessary - but also with humour to lighten the mood when the occasion arose.
The group was mixed age, mixed race, mixed gender, mixed ability and Chloe was professionally able to deliver the tour at an appropriate level to cater for all needs.
It was a cold wet miserable day but Chloe captivated us all.
I would highly recommend her as a guide for this tour.

Scottish Ryan our guide was fantastic. We learnt so much from him and he not not only talked he posed questions to the group to engage people.
Much better doing a walking tour then trying to learn the history yourself.
Ryan was so knowledgeable and could answer any question given.
Lasted just over 3 hours with one S Bahn and bus trip.
Would highly recommend this trip

The tour was excellent, our tour guide Nicholai did a great job getting the facts across to us but also a human element and telling a story. His passion for his job made it a very interesting few hours. Would highly recommend this tour to anyone who wants to find out more about WW2, Nazi Germany, The Holocaust, Hitler and the history of Berlin.

We had a great tour with Campbell. Lots of interesting facts, but also time for jokes. He took the time not only te guide us past the highlights, but also to explain the situation, the events in time that lead to the rise of the nazi’s. Also with much photo’s and illustrations to illustrate his story and eye for the little details along the way. It was an extremely cold and windy day, but even then it ended to soon for us. Would definitely recommend.

My wife and I, along with another couple of friends, did the 3rd Reich Berlin Hitler &WW11 Insider Tour in English, yesterday. Our guide was Ronan who comes from Kerry in Ireland and as an Irishman, he made us all proud to be Irish. He was absolutely brilliant and provided a non-stop commentary for four hours on a fascinating topic. His knowledge of the history of WW2 is simply fantastic and we all got the impression he could go on for hours longer. Everyone clearly were very impressed by Ronan. Well done and great value walking tour.

Nickolai was very knowledgeable about the history of the National Socialists and World War 2, in general. It was sprinkling rain off and on; Nickolai was also considerate enough to make all attempts to keep us dry. It was very interesting to see where the bunker had been where the Regime ended and the old Luftwaffe Air Force building. There were many great sites to see and so much great history! Nickolai was outstanding!

Cian did an excellent job of describing Nazi Germany, snd if great interest to me, how the Nazis achieved power so completely and horrifically. The T 4 medical atrocities was a new chapter I hadn’t been aware of. Standing at the locations where Nazi history took place was powerful and fascinating.

We did this tour our first day in Berlin, and it was a great way to get a feel for the city, as well as learn more about one of the darkest periods in world history. Marie was an awesome guide, so knowledgeable. I was a European history major and still learner a lot. We found it to be really well organized, informative, and great value for money. Wish we'd had time to do some of their other tours.

I thought I knew a lot about Berlin and its WW2 history... Oww how wrong I was!

Our guide was absolutely fantastic. Cian our Irish guide knew Berlin like the back of his hand. He explained in great detail the mesmerising history of Berlin form the beginning of WW2 until the fall of the Third Reich. Further to that, Cian answered every single question and his knowledge on Berlin and the war was phenomenal.

I had contemplated walking around Berlin visiting the sites myself, but paying for the walking tour and having Cian as a guide was excellent and worth the money and more!!! I highly recommend doing the tour.

This is a must do tour to see and understand the sites from Nazi WW2 in Berlin. The sites are spread around, in many cases not well marked or preserved as tourist sites. Jan was a great guide, professionally trained in the subject, passionate about sharing it, and enthusiastic and personable. Add all this up making a Great tour on a nice early Spring day, when I needed cheering up. (I took this tour while stuck in Germany on March 16, due to Coronavirus, uncertain when I’d get back to US, and other tours and venues all canceling). I’m so grateful this tour was not canceled. We all observed proper social distancing and responsible awareness of the virus concerns. Thank you Jan. At the end of the tour, he took the time to point me to a good route to see a nice piece of the Berlin Wall, a park with lots of English explanations, not a mile from my hotel.

It was a really educative tour. We visited many city spots of historic significance. Our tour guide Nikolai was excellent. He provided a lot of information on the history of Nazi Germany as well as on the city's past and present in general and shared with us some relatively unknown stories. He also gave us tips on what is worth visiting in Berlin. I strongly recommend this tour if you are interested in history.

We pre-booked with Insider Tours after reading the great reviews and we were not disappointed!

The meeting point was easy to find and we received a friendly welcome from the representative. We were then assigned to a group led by Maria who was, quite simply BRILLIANT! She gave us so much information along the route of the tour, but in an engaging way that was easy to listen to and absorb. We took our 13 year old daughter on the tour and were slightly worried she would get bored, but she enjoyed the tour very much and learned so much about the war and the Third Reich.

I would highly recommend Insider Tours from the experience we had and would definitely use them again for another tour if we visit Berlin.

Many thanks to Maria in particular for her wonderful knowledge and friendly service. She answered all questions very comprehensively and was helpful with the city transport systems too.

Due to Corona we were a very small group. Maria, our guide, was very well informed and could answer even tricky questions. It was fun and informative. The way Maria tells the stories really takes you back in time. I can only recommend it!

Fantastic walking tour. Our guide Maria was brilliant. I couldn’t believe how much interesting information she had inside her head! The tour was a good mix of walking, stopping for talks, one train ride (you’ll need a ticket before you start the tour), one bus ride (use the same all-day ticket as for the train), one 30 minute break in the middle for some lunch, and then a finish at the remains of the Berlin Wall. If you’re interested in the history of the Third Reich then I would thoroughly recommend it.

This was a fantastic tour. Starting at 10 and ending around 2:30 our Tour guide Nick was exceptionally knowledgable and had a great way of helping us picture the things no longer there, like Hitler's bunker which was in a car park. Accompanied with a file of pictures that Nick brought along, the tour was very well thought through, really interesting and thoroughly enjoyable. Our first day in Berlin we did the main sites like Brandenburg gate, this tour on our second day was a great accompaniment to that as it showed the less obvious, unsigned significant spots to see that we'd have otherwise missed. Highly recommend to anyone wanting to understand the significance of Berlin's history.

This tour was everything we hoped it would be. Our guide Rob is an Englishman living in Berlin. He was full of interesting information on the sites visited and any questions were answered very well. I would recommend this tour for anyone with any interest in Berlin and its history

Jamie provided a great tour of Berlin and did a great job discussing Berlin during WWII. Because of COVID-19, our group was very, very small which was quite nice. I absolutely recommend this tour to anyone wanting to get an in-depth tour of the area from someone who lives there and knows his history!!

Tour was an interesting topic. Guide information was a bit dry because it felt
like there were too many specific details at each stopping point. It made it difficult
to follow because stops were so long and lengthy. Perhaps pick the most important
detail/event of that stop and focus on that instead of trying to incorporate too much.

Our guide Nikolai, was not only knowledgeable but the nicest guy. He has the perfect ability to tell the history of the war times in such an interesting way. He took his time with no rush at all to answer questions and provide help. Highly recommended

This was the Third Reich Tour, WWII and Hitler not to be confuse with the Cold War Tour. Tom was our guide and it was a very small tour, so we could ask questions. Tom took us to out of the way places that we would never have found on our own. He made it very interesting for us and knew his history. I would highly recommend this tour and Tom if he is available. He did not give up on us even though it was raining, we certainly didn't mind.

Chloe was our guide & she was really good. Confident & passionate snot her subject - she’d obviously done her research & had loads of little asides for us. Great trip but wouldn’t recommend for little ones - subject knowledge too complex & I think they would be bored. We loved it though- hash our 15yr old son with us & would definitely recommend it.

Really ,superb informative walking tour .
Our guide Campbell was very knowledgeable and full of personality ,also was very interested in other people's opinion .
A very dark time in World and German history ,3hrs flow in as we walked through Berlin .
Thoroughly recommend.

We booked this tour for our daughter who is doing GCSE history- she thought Cian was great and we did too. He fielded any question put to him, on cars, beer, the far Right and dealt very kindly with a child in our group who peppered him with random questions.

Overall we were very impressed with the depth of knowledge Cian displayed and he made the tour very engaging for everyone. I especially liked his thoughtful introduction to the Holocaust memorial, it suited the mood very well. We left this tour feeling well educated, it was an absolute pleasure for us all.

Maria (from Brazil) was an excellent historian and guide. I learned so much myself and I also brought two teenage girls who were engaged. Maria gave us plenty of context and made our reflections on the history of the Third Reich very relevant for today.

This was an excellent tour led by Xavier who is very knowledgeable and added many side stories to the history. We started in the old Jewish area of Berlin and ended at the Reichstag. Xavier is a fantastic tour leader, story teller and historian.

This was billed as a Third Reich tour , however it was a little light on detail relating to this period. This was a more general history of Berlin walking tour. Our guide was very knowledgeable and experienced however a review of the route and talking points would be required to align to a Third Reich tour.

The tour passed in a flash! Ronan was a treasure trove of knowledge. We visited a number of great sites and he did a great job of explaining, but not over-simplifying, an important piece of history. Highly recommend as a Berlin attraction.

Great tour around the major third reich spots in Berlin. Our tour guide Cian, a history masters student had an incredible wealth of knowledge on the topic and answered all our questions very well. Cian provided extra photos in a folder at each stop which was great for context and extra info. Definitely recommend.

Campbell was a really engaging and knowledgeable guide, and encouraged questions throughout the tour. In addition to seeing key sites associated with the nazis, you will also get a good understanding of the context for their rise to power. Recommended.

We had an awesome walking tour with our guide Martin. He is a very proud modern German man with an excellent manner in presenting Third Reich Berlin in a very sensitive yet informative way. He was ready to answer any questions we threw at him and was very knowledgeable about WWII history. The walk was very easy to do all flat ground with a great break at ‘Berlin’s’ best donut shop. Thanks again Martin for such an informative tour. One we will never forget.

Fantastic tour with an incredible tour guide. Hannah Schneider elegantly traversed one of the most difficult periods in German history in a way that was accessible, personal, and encyclopedic all at the same time. We hung on her every word, and appreciated her spirited yet objective manner. Three hours flew by! Would definitely recommend!

We did a Third Reich history tour with Chloe in March. I’m a huge WWII history nerd and wanted to learn more about that time while seeing the major sights associated with Hitler and the Nazis, and this tour did not disappoint. Chloe did a great job of explaining overall historical facts, while mixing in enough personal stories to make the points seem less like a lesson and much more humanized. The whole experience was incredibly sobering and makes you think about the scale of WWII on a much deeper level. I’ve been reading about this time period in Europe for over ten years and still walked away feeling like I learned a ton. Whether you are a WWII history novice or nerd, Chloe will do a fantastic job of explaining the time period in a way that is informative yet extremely interesting. I highly recommend this tour!

This was a great tour. Our guide Nickolai was very knowledgeable and made the tour very interesting. It was a very cold day so he didn't leave us to fend the weather seeking alternative areas so be could chat with us out of the cold wind. He never rushed and was able to give an honest answer to all of our questions. Would thoroughly recommend it

This tour was truly inspirational. Our tour guide, Xavier, was very insightful and helpful throughout. He had great knowledge about Berlin and overall the history of Germany and presented it in such a way that was both educational and fun. We got to see many important landmarks that invited us to reflect upon our history. Xavier was also extremely respectful of our needs and made sure we were comfortable at all times. Ultimately, a once in a lifetime experience!!

Our tour guide Pip was really informative, how she retained 4 hours of information in her head amazed me! We got a really good overview of the history and she recommended films and activities along the way that supported what we were hearing about. I left feeling educated about the subject and feeling like I’d covered a lot of ground in Berlin! I would book again for a different tour as it was a positive experience. Wear some comfy shoes, the tour is 3-4hrs but excellent value.

Our guide Campbell was extremely knowledgable and interesting. His demeanor and manner were great, made you feel very comfortable to ask questions and gain a better understanding. He always made sure the group was well informed and was able to answer all questions using an extensive knowledge of information. Very professional. One of the best out there

Overall good, but felt that the balance between talking, walking, and seeing needs to be improved. Didn't feel like I saw much for the amt of time spent on the tour and a lot of the talking was not about Hitler and/or WWII. Guide could also speak slower and more fluidly.

Our Guide Nikolai was absolutely awesome! His historical knowledge of the Third Reich Berlin was extremely thorough and detailed. Our 3 plus hour walking tour took us all through the Mitte area of Berlin and beyond. He also ensured we stayed safe during our tour with COVID considerations (masks and social distancing) adhered to during our tour. Highly recommend this tour to anyone coming to Berlin and wanting to know its history.

We went on this tour with Chloe today. She came across very passionate about the subject and the tour was very informative. Chloe answered all questions with enthusiasm and made sure to point out the forgotten victims of the third reich

Wednesday 29th January 2020.
Went on walk with Nickolai touring Hitlers and WWII main areas of points of interest around Berlin.
He's a very knowledgeable and informative guide. Questions were allowed and because of the cold weather he always thought of ways to get us out of the cold briefly to discuss what we had seen.
Easy meet up point and he makes sure at the end of the tour that you can find your way back.
I would highly recommend this tour.
Thanks so much Nickolai. As a first time visitor to Berlin this was a great way to find out more about Hitlers Regime.

An interesting and thorough tour of the last days of WWII and the Third Reich. Jim was enthusiastic about the content which made the tour very engaging and informative.

Though the tour was long and in the heat of summer, Jim was considerate in finding us lots of shade to stand in which made the experience quite comfortable.

Overall I would recommend this tour and our guide Jim!

We really enjoyed this walking tour, it was so interesting. Our tour guide, Nickolai, is very knowledgeable and personable , you can tell he truly likes what he does. If you’re into history like me, I recommend this tour, hands down!

Had a tour with Nick today and I really found it very interesting and informative.he took his time to explain all about the period and asking a question was met with a very detailed answer.

No problem recommending both Insider tours and Nick.

Had a chance to tour with Campbell as our tour guide. Such a wonderful tour. His love of history made his storytelling so relatable. For a tour as serious as the third reich this one experience was educational and enlightening. He challenged us to think about the different scenarios and was attentive, engaged and so open and willing to answer questions. The tour itself is very central, doesn’t seem like a long walk. There’s so much to see and learn about this time in history. The Reichstag, the Luftwaffe, the SS. The horrors of the holocaust. Great tour. Highly recommended.

Pip/Phillipa did a great job! As a historian her tour was brilliantly nuanced in the way she presented and discussed the pressures and temperatures of the times, and how people were effected. She trained with a focus on women in history, and as a ww2 history fan this gave the tour a very refreshing and fascinating angle. I learned a lot and thoroughly enjoyed it!

This tour was informative, engaging, and worth every penny! Our tour guide, Yan, braved the cold and rain to provide us with a great tour filled with fascinating history. If you're interested at all in the Third Reich/WWII History/Hitler make sure to set time aside during your stay in Berlin to take this tour. It will not disappoint!

We really enjoyed this walking tour. Our guide, Nikolai was very passionate and knowledgeable about the history of Hitler and the Third Reich. Highly recommend if you have the time while in Berlin. We learned and saw a lot of stuff that we would have missed without going on this tour.

During our brief visit to the city, we decided to take this tour and we were NOT disappointed. Our guide JOSH was very knowledgeable and helpful throughout the tour. He answered many questions not even specific to the tour... Thanks Josh!!

What an excellent way to get a lot of information about WW2 and Berlin. Can absolutely recommend it to everyone. We've done it 8 years ago with another guide, and was afraid, that we'd seen and heard it all. But we wanted out adult boys to have the tour too. Not to worry - every guide uses their personal background and experience, and we got to know even more about Berlin.

We are extremely grateful to our guide, Tobi, for a fantastic experience. Tobi was extremely knowledgeable, funny, kind, and brought Berlin's past to life for us. The tour was packed with sights and information. A must-do during your trip to Berlin.

Brilliant and in depth tour led by guide Thomas who had an excellent knowledge of the period. 3 hours meant we could go into detail and really understand the history. Tour stops at some of Berlins most iconic places, highly recommended AAA +++

Thank you to Ronan for taking us on this tour!
Ronan was very knowledgeable and I could have spoken to him all day about this kind of stuff. The tour visited some great sites with interesting history with the bunker right at the end of the tour. The tour was paced well and there was plenty of time to ask questions.

This walking tour was very well organized and occurred on a very warm day with temps hovering around 95 degrees. Ciam, our guide, was always cognizant of where to find shade and a stop along the way to re-hydrate. I appreciated that since I was probably one of the older ones in the group. The meeting spot was easy to find. Ciam is very knowledgeable about Hitler/Third Reich/WWII and other additional, non-related facts, that were interesting nonetheless. There was no were to sit on this tour and comfortable walking shoes are a must. I would recommend this tour highly.

The tour was really very informative, explaining how Hitler and Nazi came into power and maintained absolute power throughout those years. Our guide, Nikolai was really knowledgeable on the topic. I particularly like how he ended the tour with a thought provoking question on the line between reistance and acceptance.

Jim was a great guide and I really enjoyed all the knowledge he shared with us. As others mentioned it was a hot day and he was very considerate about finding space and making sure people got water at stops etc. Would take tour again. Learned so much and made me want to keep doing research after the tour.

My friends and I had a great time on this tour. Yan was very informative and kept everyone engaged. Thoroughly enjoyed it and would highly recommend. A great way to learn more about the history of Berlin! Yan was an excellent tour guide.
Our tour guide Asaf was excellent. Roughly 3 hours. Several stops along the way to rest your feet if necessary. Bring water and use the bathroom before you start. Not many options along the way.

Weve been on the tour today and wanted to review immediately. Our tour guide Martin was fabulous from start to finish. As a previous guide at a concentration camp he had extra knowledge to add. He was interactive, informative and a lovely man. It’s amazing value and a fascinating 4 hours. Thoroughly recommended. Thank you Martin! X

Without doubt one of the best ways to find out about the history of the third reich in Berlin. Chloe was an excellent tour guide - really engaging and friendly. Our only regret is that we didn’t book any other walking tours with Insider Tour.

I had two bothers who were in WW II, one who was in Berlin during and after the fall of the Third Reich. They are both part of history now,but this monument reminds me of their time and sacrifices. It, also, broght back my realization of why I spent 30 years in the U S military.

This is a must see for any one who visits the area.

This was my first visit to Berlin and this was a great start. We had a three hour tour with Martin. He was a perfect guide - full of knowledge, witty and polite. I sincerely recommend this tour and our guide Martin.

Our guide Ronan made the history and the stories so interesting. He engaged the whole group. What ever question we had, he could answer.
It was really a great experience. Next time we are in Berlin, we would like to try an another walk.

This was a great tour. Our guide Jamie was very passionate and knowledgeable. So many highlights including the Reichstag, the Soviet War Memorial in the Tiergarten and the Federal Ministry of Defense to name just a few. A good value. Highly recommend.

Incredibly informative tour guide (Hein) and well paced. Great overview of Third Reich history and a helpful orientation tour of downtown Berlin. Highly recommended as the first activity on your visit to Berlin!

We went on this tour with our three sons and had a great time. Jim was helpful and informative. He did not overload you with information but clearly had an in depth knowledge of the history of the third reich and was easily capable of answering questions. Great value for money.

This historical tour was beyond fantastic. Nickolai was a very knowledgeable person with lots of information I didn’t learn in my history classes. Seeing the sites and hearing about them gave me a whole new perspective. I’m very glad I took engaged in this tour from Viatour.

The guide was very knowledgeable, however there was not too much to see, when going to a building which had a whole 3 floors of info, we were just given a talk in the stairwell. We left tour to stay and see the museum. I had e expected more about the Third Reich and Hitler

On September 10th we were fortunate enough to have Barnaby as our guide
for the World War II walking tour. He was certainly well educated on everything
to do with the Third Reich and somehow he managed to make it entertaining!
It was a large group and Barnaby was able to keep us all together (even on
public transport) . He imparted his knowledge with great humor and kept the entire group engaged. I would highly
recommend this Insider Tour....especially with Barnaby!.

Great tour by foot in the center of Berlin, Maria the Guide was excellent and provided us with lots of information about WWII, very impressive. I walked by places the day before and missed all the details but during the tour it became very clear :)
Amazing experience. Full of details and interesting facts. I'd go back to Berlin just to have this tour again.

We loved the Third Reich Berlin walking tour! Our guide, Nickolai, did an amazing job! You could see that he had so much information about this subject and he was very passionate about it as well. He answered all our questions in a well thought way and loved to discuss all topics with us. The meeting point was clear and obvious. Even though it was rainy and cold, Nickolai made our tour interesting and thought provoking. He would try his best to plan out times to be out of the rain or cold weather. Nickolai gave a very honest view about the history of the Third Reich, which we appreciated. Although many of the building have been destroyed, he showed us pictures to show what it once looked like. He was so passionate about telling us all the history that our tour went over by an hour, which we did not mind!! Our group really enjoyed him and I would highly recommend this group to anyone interested in learning more about this time in history. Definitely a highlight for our time in Berlin!

We took the «last days of the third reich» tour with Barnaby today. It felt like a very behind-the-scenes trip as Barnaby had a lot of interesting information you can’t read in books. Even though the weather was cold, the 4 hour tour went by fast and we were so glad we did it.

Joined the tour with a friend, and met Barnaby as guide. Excellent! Barnaby provided detailed information of the topic as well as amusing anecdotes throughout the journey. Respectful of the topic at all times, Barnaby's discussion gave me much greater insight to the events and effects of the third Reich in both Berlin and the wider world. Highly recommend the tour and Barnaby's guiding.

Highly recommended. Maria is an excellent tour guide and extremely knowledgeable. Her sense of humour and drama background shone through. Maria was attentive to all party members and spoke excellent English.

My sons and I learned a lot on this tour. Jan was a very knowledgeable guide and was able to communicate complex historical situations in a clear and understandable manner. Believe it or not, he used a stick to draw maps and hierarchies in the dirt and it was very effective. He was able to answer in depth questions and kept us all engaged in the history.

There is a fair amount of walking on this tour, so be prepared for that.

This is a great tour for anyone with an interest in history, especially World War II history.

Barnaby is an excellent guide. Lots of info on ugly period of history. Definitely worth doing if interested in learning about end of WWII. Tour departed on time. Moved along at steady clip. Stopped periodically to gain more insight. Ended as planned at 2:00pm. Highly recommend.

We had a great tour around Berlin with Marie. She was extremely knowledgeable about the stories of World War II and provided a lot of insight into the war and how it affected the world. We saw some very interesting sites and Marie provided a lot of detail around them. Great tour. Would recommend for anyone.

We had Ronan as our tour guide and he was amazing! All of the guides seemed to speak English very well so the tour was very easy to understand. Meeting place was very easy to find. Ronan is a HIGHLY educated individual in WW2, was able to answer any questions we had, and is very enthusiastic about WW2. Cheers to you Ronan!

My partner is an absolute history nut and although after living in Berlin for 5 years i could take him to various sites, there's no way i could have provided all the extra information that Mike gave.

My 14-year-old son and I had two full days in Berlin back in March 2018, and as first-timers to the city, we decided to fill each one with a walking tour from INSIDER TOUR as recommended by Rick Steves. The first tour, THIRD REICH BERLIN, was one of several 4-hour walking tours that meet daily at 10 am, in front of the McDonalds in S+U Zoologischer Garten. It's impossible to miss it if you are traveling by train - you walk up the stairs and the golden arches are staring you right in the face, and all around are lots of smiling, easily identifiable folks in the yellow ponchos.

When you walk up (hopefully by 9:45 am...because you won't be late and hold up the group?) you are pointed to someone from the company who will take your money and give you a ticket. It was so easy, I'm not sure why anyone would want to buy this ticket ahead of time....that 10% discount doesn't seem like it's worth the added anxiety of a late arrival.

After that's done, you find the person leading your group. There are usually a half dozen guides (or more) giving various tours in various languages, but the English speaker was not hard to find. He introduced himself as Barnaby, and around 10 am we set off as a group of 9.

Barnaby did a wonderful job of the tour, showing us the most significant sites of WW2, among them the (renamed) Stauffenbergstrasse, Tiergarten, Reichstag, Brandenburg Gate, Memorial to the Murdered Jews (an underrated, thoughtful place), Hitler's former bunker site, and the former Luftwaffe headquarters. Barnaby was extremely informative and always remain engaged with the group, inviting feedback on the sights and settings and mood of the participants. Much of it is rather heavy material, and we knew that going in, but I thought Barnaby struck a great tone throughout. We loved our time on the tour and were surprised 4 hours went by so quickly, but it was time well spent learning about the historical context of WW2 Berlin. Overall, I thought it was the perfect use of our time and would unequivocally recommend it if you're interested in the subject.

Booked this walking tour via Viator before travelling to Berlin for a long weekend at the end of January 2018.
Meeting point was at the Zoologischer Garten railway station at 10.00am where we were met by the Insider Tour team.
Mike was our guide and he was warm and friendly from the outset.
As January is fairly quiet for tourists in Berlin there was only 3 of us (me and a couple of great Irish boys) on the tour with Mike.
Tour started with us getting a bus through the old embassy quarter of Berlin (Japan, Italy, Austria....) to the German Resistance Memorial Center.
I was unaware of this Memorial Centre and it was an informative and moving experience.
Next it was on to the The Memorial and Information Point for the Victims of National Socialist Euthanasia Killings (T4), again this was very moving and reminded us of the extreme cruelty of the Nazi regime.
We then made our way through the Tiergarten to the Soviet War Memorial.
Mike's knowledge of all the place's visited was highly impressive and he also welcomed any questions from our small group.
Next it was on to the Akademie der Künste (Academy of Arts) where Albert Speer had his office (the stairs to his office have been preserved in a wall of the building).
The tour then continued to The Führerbunker (carpark), down Wilhelmstraße past the Luftwaffe Headquarters, with the tour then finishing at the Topography of Terror.
The tour lasted four and a half hours so if you are doing it in winter wrap-up well.
Finally, I just want to thank Mike again, the tour was brilliant and I would highly recommend it.

Please consider giving her a raise, even our 12 and 10 year old were spell bound. Well worth the money. She showed us places that we would not have found with out her. For example Hitler’s Bunkers was only a block from where we stayed.

I really enjoyed and recommend the Third Reich Tour with Bernaby. He is very passionated for the history of the war and for the city. Besides that, he gladly answered all of my questions. I really recommend the Third Reich Tour with Bernaby, considering that is a great way to escape from the basic tours, since you will learn more and the groups are smaller.

We went on this tour as a group of friends and it was fascinating although very sobering at the same time. If you are into your WW2 history then this is a must. Our tour guide was Barnaby and he was excellent. Highly recommended!

I had a limited time in Berlin, and this tour was exactly what I was looking for. Barnaby was a wonderful guide, very informative and eager to discuss history and answer everyone's questions. It was evident that history is a real passion of his, which added much to the experience. He also did a great job of keeping everyone engaged with little trivia questions throughout—I got enough of them right to win a free pretzel at the end of the tour! And the path we took was perfect; we walked past many of the major landmarks of Berlin, so there were several photo opportunities along the way. Honestly, I can't recommend this tour highly enough. A marvelous way to spend a few hours learning some history and better getting to know Berlin.

The title suggests the tour will cover the final days of WWII with the approach of the Soviet army into Berlin. It certainly does that but it also takes you to several other sites to give an overall history of Berlin during the war. Our tour guide Pip was excellent, easy going and informative. You could tell that history was a real passion for her in her presentation - it was more than just rattling off a list of dates & facts. she brought the stories to life in a very vivid way.

One of the best tours I have been on. He was very knowledgeable and interactive with everyone in the tour group. He was very informative about every place we visited and gave you a chance to ask questions. If you are at all interested in WW2 this is a perfect tour and trust me you will learn new things! A plus is you get to see most of the memorials and museums in a 4 hour period.

My friend and I booked this trip on a whim the day before we arrived in Berlin. The reviews were what convinced us to buy this particular tour and I am so happy that we did. Barnaby was our tour guide and he was amazing. He was knowledgeable and made the tour very personal. He was interested in our group as individuals and what led us to take this tour on our holiday. It was set at a relaxing pace and the information was delivered with a passion and respect for the very serious subject. I wholeheartedly recommend this tour to anyone with at least a passing interest in Berlin and it’s history. Thank you again, Barnaby and Insider Tour!!

We had a tour guide called Pip who really knew her facts but also gave added information which helped us to reflect. It was a well thought through and well prepared presentation. An excellent walking tour which took us round all the main WWII sites.
Our guide was Barnaby, and he could not have been more engaging and interesting. Thoroughly recommended, the best thing I did in the city by far.
Excellent tour! Barnaby was knowledgeable, friendly, and very approachable. Lots of walking, but learned a lot and saw many important sites.

Throually enjoyed my four hours of touring with Chloe. She was very knowledgeable about all of the spots we visited and encouraged conversation with the guests, making it more personal and interesting. I only had one day to explore Berlin and feel I made the best use of my time and money.
Our tour guide Chloe did a great job and the tour was very informative and interesting. If you like WW2 history this is the tour for you.

We had our tour guide Chloe give us a fantastic tour of museums and memorials with her own catalog photographs from the war-era. Chloe set the scene for us in each location, providing relevant pre-war history and bits of information she had personally collected. Amazing value for money and would recommend as a must no matter how long you are visiting for. Thank you for an amazing tour Chloe!

This was the best walking tour I’ve been on in any city I’ve travelled. Chloe, our guide, was knowledgeable, informative, funny, friendly & enthusiastic until the end. At 14e for 4+ hrs (not including tip 😉) it was also the best value for money tour I’ve ever been on.
Thanks again Chloe !

A great tour with a difficult subject matter made interesting and enjoyable by Taylor the guide who really knew all the facts and explained it perfectly. If you're reading this and thinking about it, just book it. If the subject matter isn't really your thing, go anyway - you'll be surprised how much you get drawn into the history of those events, again made digestible by Taylor.

A good overview of Berlin - totally worth it! And I will be recommending it to others traveling to Berlin and looking for a comprehensive tour with knowledgable guides.

Pip knew her stuff and added subtle details to the tour that didn't underplay the role of the Soviet Union or the allies, while acknowledging the consequences of the end of World War II and the division after it. Her commentary painted a fair and thoughtful picture of the last days of the war and also challenged us to think about some of our assumptions and motivations.

Having said that, there were a few things I would have changed about the "organization" of the tour. The website did say to bring "An AB travel zone ticket is required for this tour." I wish they had have been more specific and actually detail in full the transit needs of this tour (I ended up buying two full tickets after already having bought a ticket to the start location - a day pass would have been cheaper AND in retrospect, I could have purchased a "short" ticket for one of the legs instead of the full ticket).

Also, I am not sure why we met somewhere from which we almost immediately had to take the train to start the tour. While, from a tour company logistics point of view having several tours meeting in the same place at the same time is easier, there didn't seem to be much logic for this as a start point for our tour.

But overall, I was very impressed with the content and the knowledge of the guides and believe it was time and money well spent.

I went on this same walk back in 2013 and since then this walk has never left me, I knew I had to do it again which I did last week.

Jamie our tour guide was unbelievable, it's amazing how much knowledge one person can hold in their head! But it was far more than just reciting facts, Jamie gave true insight into driving factors whilst painting a picture of Berlin during World War 2 that just captivated the whole group.

I CANNOT recommend this tour, and Jamie, enough. Once again it was one of the most enriching activities I've done!
Jakub is a very good host. Took us to places we'd have struggled to find ourselves. Walking pace good for all abilities

Excellent and informative. Jamie looked after us and answered our questions with an amazing knowledge. We would highly recommend this tour to help make sense of what happened and why. A must do tour. If you're reading this book now....
Absolutely great tour. Highlight of our trip. Jamie really brought his subject to life and had an encyclopedic knowledge. Stupidly cheap too.
Andy was a great tour guide and the tour was full of interesting insights and sights! Thanks so much. Would recommend.

We enjoyed an interesting walking tour 'Third Reich..' with Mike as our tour. We are interested in history, especially WWII so being in the heart of former's Hitlers capitol was so interesting and enjoyable. The tour was well prepared and arranged. It was good to see all those places you could read in books and see in movies! Mike - few words about our guide: he is talented to tell stories, he is very knowledgeable, able to answer all even detailed and difficult questions and we liked his sense of humor.. One of best guide we met. Highly recommended for all WWII fans! Thanks Mike!

An excellent tour following the trail of the Soviet forces as they seized BERLIN in the last days of World War II. The idea of tracking the route of the major Soviet armies was inspired and provided a real sense of the terrain and movement towards the Reichstag and the final moments of the Nazi regime. Taylor was an excellent and knowledgeable guide for this small group. No questions remained unanswered! Congratulations on constructing such an informative and interesting tour that transversed the city. Taylor as an Australian demonstrated great passion for the subject like his colleague also from the land down under who took the off the beaten path Berlin tour the previous day. Fantastic.
Yan was very knowledgable, tells a great story and - despite so much post war rebuild - really brings the past alive as we move through the various sites. Highly recommend!

Such an affordable guide that was worth the time and money. Yan is a very knowledgeable and interesting guide. So glad we chose to do this, perfect if you want to see and learn a lot and do not have a lot of time.

Barneby was very knowledgable and patiently answered all my questions.
The tour was excellent, not too long and I loved hearing about the history of Berlin.
I highly recommend the tour and Barneby as an excellent guide.
Daniel

Yan is a terrific tour guide. He knows so much about Nazi Germany! He really brought that era to life for our group.
His mastery of English is striking and he has a great speaking voice. This tour was very informative AND very fun. It was our last day in Berlin and we felt really fortunate to be on this tour.

Our tour guide Pip Roper was awesome. Her vast knowledge and insights made for a wonderful educational experience. She welcomed questions and input from all of us while maintaining a good pace. My adult daughter and I thoroughly enjoyed our day.

With this walking tour you get to see a lot of the city and at the same time learn a lot about the end of World War 2.
Alicia was a very good guide with deep knowledge and kept a balance between being funny and serious on this important topic.

The tour was very good & touched on many different topics & places. The tour guide (Barnaby) was great & added a sense of light-heartedness to an otherwise dark subject-matter, with his classic British humour. Thanks again Barn (we should have bought you a beer)!
Chloe was great and very informative. Also accidentally was late and they made it easy to find the group

Toured in 16th Jan 19. Cannot speak highly enough of tour. Indeed they should charge more money for it. Barnaby was super knowledgeable super helpful and super tall (and I am 6'5""). My highlight was how he handled the group after the holocaust museum. Bravo. If you have the time please make it a must do. Carl

Our tour guide Barnaby was a fantastic guide and took our group through sites relating to the last days of the Third Reich. No need for him to hold an umbrella or flag up so his group can follow him, he is (literally) head and shoulders above everyone and we hung on his every word as he showed us numerous sites around the city. He was funny, engaging and knowledgeable...my only criticism would be that he clearly is a full book on this era of history and our family would personally have loved him to delve into it in more detail...it was a little light-on in terms of information for us....however for most I am sure it is absolutely perfect. Be prepared to have your walking shoes on, you cover a lot of kms. Highly recommended.

Barnaby was great fun and engaging. He looked after everyone in the group really well. Was stepped in knowledge and appeared really passionate about the subject matter.
Would recommend to anyone.

Myself and my boyfriend did a tour with Barnaby on Friday morning. We were both very impressed and would recommend the tour to anybody visiting Berlin who has an interest in it's history.
The tour lasted was 4 hours, and took us on a good walk around the city, with a stop for coffee in the middle.
Barnaby is an excellent guide, very informed on so many details about the war and also Berlin in general. He was very passionate and spoke very well about all sorts of subjects (some not very pleasant to talk about.)
He also helped us after the tour with food and bar reccomendations and marked them on a map for us which was very appreciated!
If we come back to Berlin we would definitely do another tour with this group!
For 14 euro this is an excellent way to spend a few hours in a great city, and we learned a lot!

Alicia took us on a "tour d'horizon" starting from the foundation of Germany in 1871 to the end of WW2. For anybody interested in German history, this program can be highly recommended as it is substantiated with the relevant Berlin locations.
In total, this was an outstanding tour through a very competent guide.
Thank you Alicia, from Peter and Julian

This tour tells a brief but visual history of Berlin in WW2, and thankfully does not dwell on battles or warfare but humanity. Interesting visits to various locations which are fascinating, and out tour guide Barnaby was excellent: inciteful, informed, humorous and affable.

I'd very highly recommend this tour to anyone in town. Great value.

Excellent tour with Barnaby, a knowledgeable guide, who managed to strike a fine balance between showing us the sights, yet reminding everyone of the true horrors of the times.
Good value for money & would recommend.
Our tour guide Campbell was excellent. He had great historical knowledge and was really engaging. Interesting and enjoyable tour. Would highly recommend it.

Our guide, Mike, was excellent. He knew his history well and was entertaining and energetic on our tour. My history-loving son (14) thoroughly enjoyed this tour, didn't feel the need to "correct" our guide's facts and didn't mind the long walk around town.

The tour covered many key sites of the Third Reich but didn't seem to focus on the "final days of WWII in Berlin." Excellent tour nonetheless. We enjoyed learning about the resistors at the German Resistance Museum.

There was a break for lunch that helped give us all time to sit for a few minutes.
Highly recommend. Barnaby was our guide, a good egg. Very knowledgeable and insightful. A terrible time in history but so worthwhile taking this tour.
Our guide was Barnaby - he was really entertaining and had a thorough knowledge of Berlin and WWII. Highly recommend!

We have just returned from the Final Days of WW2 Walking Tour of Berlin. Our guide Alicia was fantastic - very knowledge and interesting. She brought to life the war years and I would definitely recommend this tour. There was a lot of information about the period leading up to the outbreak of the war that I had was unaware of. I've come away feeling a smarter for my four hours spent in her company. Highly recommend this.

We had Jan as our tour guide and boy does he know his stuff. With perfect English, his knowledge of the third (and 1st and 2nd) Reich was immense. We swept from pre war to post war seamlessly, with all Jan’s anecdotes and stories bringing the history to life. He has a great presence and used innovative methods to tell us the tale. We even went an hour or two over which was fine. Highly recommend it.

We had our tour with Chloe on the 27th August. It was genuinely brilliant - informative, well planned out and amazing for the price we paid. Will definitely have another Insider Tour when we visit Berlin again!

A very fun and informative 4hour experience throughout the various monuments in berlin. Chloe was extremely knowledgeable and took the time to make sure that everyone enjoyed the experience. Finished the tour at topography of terrors which is a great location to continue on your own journey. 5/5 budget friendly experience.

Took this tour today with Barnaby, who is an excellent if a bit quirky guide. A native of England you'll have no problem understanding him. He's very knowledgeable about the history of Berlin during the final days of Nazism and of Hitler's end. Tour took a bit over 4 hours, with a 25 minute (very necessary) break about 1/2 way. Saw so much and learned so much about the times of the end of the Reich, as well of course some of the history of the rise to power of Hitler. Very moving stop at the Memorial to the murdered Jews of Europe as well as the place where the executions of all the plotters to kill Hitler took place after the failed assassination attempt known as Valkyrie.
Pip was a brilliant guide. The tour was informative and interesting from start to end. Pip was very passionate and knowledgeable. Highly recommend the tour

A hugely interesting and informative walking tour with Mike..very well put together and his explanations of what happened at this time in history was put across in a non political manner just his very inteligent thoughts and insite into Berlin.
First class guide..would certainly do it again if back in Berlin[if Mike was available again!]

On the 19th July I did this tour with Taylor as our guide. He was fantastic! Extremely knowledgeable and interesting with a great balance of factual detail and smaller 'stories'. As a history teacher I thought I may get stuck listening to information I already knew but this tour was full of new information. I highly recommend this tour. Excellent value for money. Thanks Taylor.

Wow is all I can say
For £13 for 4 hours,what great value
JJ our tour guide was superb he knew his stuff and put it across with enthusiasm and real humour.
Being a practicing teacher he would get an ofsted outstanding.
We covered a long distance but it was worth every step and has certainly be the highlight of my holiday.
Thanks JJ keep up the good work!

Jamie conducted our 4 hour tour, he was excellent. He clearly understood his subject and conveyed it very well with good insights. The tour itself was on a hot day, but Jamie found us plenty of shade and included a 25 minute break for lunch. The tour (3rd Reich Berlin) covered several perspectives and proved an excellent introduction to the subject, which can be explored further in surrounding museums.

My 10 year old son just finished studying WWII in school, so this tour was a fantastic way to see sights of historical significance first hand. Our tour guide John was absolutely fantastic! We showed up late and then forgot out tickets in the car, but John waited for us. The tour was super informative and enjoyable. John even brought historical photographs to supplement the history lesson. Definitely a great way to learn history and see Berlin at the same time! Highly recommended!

On a very hot day, we spent 4 hours with our guide Barnaby walking sites like Hitler's bunker, Valkyrie operation building, Transport ministry for Eichman, Goering' defence ministry and ruins of Himmler's SS and Gestapo HQ. Very knowledgeable guide, and lively exposition of not so funny subject.

This was the highlight of my stay in Berlin. Mike from New Zealand, was an entertaining and informative guide that you couldn't but get carried away back to that dark time in Germany's history. Mike clearly new his stuff and was always answering questions.

The Tour is great and takes in some fascinating sites while Mike tells you the story of how Berlin fell.

A must do tour and if you are lucky enough to get Mike then you are in for a treat.
Very informative tour led by knowledgeable guide Taylor.Would definitely use again on our next visit.

Had my history teacher been as fun, interesting and knowledgeable as our tour guide, Barnaby, my marks would have gone through the roof.

The tour was really terrific and my teenage daughters listened attentively to the whole tour which is itself proof of how interesting it was. They enjoyed the tour as much as we did.

Thank you Barnaby!!!

@Caroline O'Leary - your son is a fantastic guide!

John Jerome (JJ) was very knowledgeable and passionate about WWII history. It was a hot day in Berlin. He managed to keep our fairly big group engaged for 4.5 hours. You can read books and watch documentaries all day, but nothing compares to a great tour guide telling stories at the location where the events took place. Our teenagers enjoyed the tour as much as the adults. We appreciated John's humor as well. Thanks for a great start of 4th of July in Berlin!

Took the tour with John the Irishman. His knowledge and level of detail was outstanding. Really painted a great picture of the final days during World War II. Thoroughly enjoyed his tour and wouldn’t hesitate to take another with him.

Really outstanding tour and a highlight of our holiday to Berlin. Fascinating locations and stories, from Hitler's bunker to site of former Gestapo HQ. Important not to forget and to understand, given the re-emergence of extreme right wing in European and American politics. Michael also appears in a historical documentary on Youtube (Fortress Berlin, Natzi Megastructures). Highly recommended.
John Jerome was easily the most knowledgeable guide we ever had, private or group tour. Can't do any better.

John Jerome was our guide and and was outstanding. Despite having to contend with protests in Berlin he structured the tour in such a way that we missed nothing and the route fitted with the narrative of the final days of WW2 perfectly.
JJ really knew his history and brought the tour alive with his excellent story telling. The group was fairly large but he took good care of the group finding shade (it was a really hot day) and speaking clearly so everyone could hear. Me and my teenage son were so impressed with him that we stuck with Insider Tours for our next three tours.
Jamie was our guide and he was excellent. He has a PHD in archeology and his knowledge of the third Reich and Berlin seems to have no borders. His humor and manner of speaking add to the experience.

This review is a bit late, for which my apologies to Michael.
My brother and I visited Berlin in October last year and took this tour with Michael as our guide.
The pace was perfect, Michael’s knowledge was encyclopaedic, and he was happy to discuss questions without expressing bias. Michael’s voice is clear and (despite my hearing impairment) easily heard above the Berlin traffic.
I learnt an enormous amount about the topic and about Berlin in general; utterly fascinating.
I can thoroughly recommend this tour and guide.

Thoroughly enjoyed being with and learning from John as we walked thru Berlin yesterday. He was very knowledgeable and engaging as he shared the story of the final days of WW2. As it was a hot day he consistently found shade for us to hear this compelling story. Thank you John - it was a great tour!!!
Thomas D.

Pip is very professional and very knowledgeable and a pleasure to be guided by. Like the best of guides anywhere, she exhibited curiosity about each of us personally and then adeptly shaped her presentation to respond to our individual interests, and thus we who began as strangers finished with a camaraderie that was genuine. We saw the various memorials to the victims of the Third Reich, the remaining buildings of the period, and several museums, for all of which Pip provided excellent context (her Reichstag presentation is especially good). Highly recommended! [P.S. to Pip’s mum: she says you like to read nice things about her, which no doubt happens frequently; let me just say you should be proud, she’s a pip indeed.]
Very good tour, guide Roman was VERY knowledgeable (has degrees in history and archeology) - if you have 3-4 hours, well worth the time.

I went on April 25, 2018 and had the tour guide Nickolai. What a great tour! I was scared at first because 4 hr walking tour sounded a bit daunting. But its really not 4 hrs of walking but it is 4 hrs of great information. And its not just the end of WWII, he gives the events leading up to it which provided insight. Ive done a few historical walking tours before this in other cities, but hands down this is top of my list!

We took two Insider Tours while we were in Berlin. The Cold War tour with Taylor and the Last Days of World War Two with Mike.
Both Taylor and Mike were incredibly knowledgable, super engaging and dynamic in their delivery. We enjoyed each tour for different reasons, but the level of detail is really amazing. If you have an interest in the Second World War - particularly German resistance to the Nazi regime, and the Battle for Berlin, then the Last Days of World War Two is the tour for you. Mike is amazingly passionate about his subject and his enthusiasm was infectious. There is not too much walking (although it was wet when we were there and not sure if the route changed a bit because of that), and the pace is good.
The Cold War tour takes in more sights, including sections of the the Berlin Wall, and has more travel (you have to have a A&B zone day pass). Taylor's knowledge of the subject was wonderful, no question was too much effort. He asked questions of the group quite a lot which I really liked, and hung around at the end of the tour to give us travel suggestions and where to buy doughnuts etc!
Both were amazing - I would highly recommend these tours to anyone.

Jamie was our amazingly knowledgable guide leading this fantastic tour. As we walked from stop to stop, he described in great detail and clarity the events that had taken place. He really brought these events to life in a way that we could not have experienced by just reading information boards. Jamie was a wealth of information and talked as we walked giving us details of the background and build up to whole picture of this terrible period of history.
I would recommend anyone to do this tour, as Jamie got the balance of relating facts in an engaging and memorable way but without swamping us with unnecessary information.
We managed to pack in many sights that we would not necessarily have seen on our own. Well done Jamie and thank you.

A great opportunity to see many of the places that I, as an amateur history buff, had read so much about. The guide, Jamie, really knew his stuff and was able to field all questions, whether directly related to the tour or not, with aplomb. Well worth it, and really rounded off my trip to Berlin well

A must do if visiting Berlin!
Recommend doing it on your first day, get to grips with the city.

Our guide, RONAN, was incredibly knowledgeable and passionate about Berlin’s history. Set the scene perfectly. I have also studied WW2 and the 3rd reich a lot throughout my degree. RONAN still gave me news facts and put interesting twists on theories and posed some interesting historical questions.

Make sure you wear comfy shoes!! My I watch counted 15,000 steps in the 4 hours! Thanks guys. Great start to the holiday. 🚶‍♂️👍

Did this tour with Barnaby as the guide.
He knew his stuff and delivered it in a way that kept us all interested and amused and in particular managed to keep my 13 year old daughter interested which is a tough gig.
You get much morte out of a tour like this than a guide book so highly recommend it
Had a great guide in JJ extremely knowledgeable, friendly and approachable would highly recommend this tour!

We signed up for the Third Reich tour on a cold Sunday morning. Couldn't recommend this enough. It was easily the highlight of our trip to Berlin.
We learned so much, and our guide Ronan had us hooked from the start. Was a bit apprehensive about a 4 hour walking tour, but we could easily have done another couple hours it was so entertaining!
If you're in Berlin, DO THIS!

Great way to see Berlin; Our tour guide was called Jamie and he was great. There was only 5 of us in the group so it felt very personal, great value for money. Fit so much in in the 4 hours, and Jamie really knew his stuff. Would highly recommend to anyone, and only 10 euros with the Berlin Welcome Card!

We just did the 3rd Reich tour today with Barnaby and it was excellent. Even having read and studied a lot about WWII Barnaby had a plethora of details to add and seeing the locations while hearing about the history if the best way to experience history. Highly Recommended.

My daughter and I really enjoyed this tour. Barnaby is a wealth of information and he was very personable. We had limited time in Berlin and this tour visited almost every placed we wanted to go, and a few we didn't know about. This tour is highly recommended and a great value for the price.

Well the tour touches on a rather grim subject, to be sure, but gathering a personal understanding of 20th century events in Berlin helps you orient yourself in a bustling city full of distractions. Barnaby, our guide, was spectacular and full of interesting stories to help you understand a rather chaotic history. HIs ability to tell you about the more specific parts of the climate leading up to and during the Nazi era help you understand a period that can seem difficult to grasp in its entirety. Fascinating, excellent value, and well worth a half-day spent discovering one of the many sides of Berlin. Highly suggest!

Barnaby was a mine of information and looked out for everyone. I learned a lot, which was partly why I went to Berlin. There were enough stops to enable us to last the distance i.e. the older ones, which was good as it was a really hot day.
would thoroughly recommend this tour to anyone interested in world war 2 berlin. informative tour with Michael.

Barnaby provided our group with a wealth of information and encouraged thoughtful reflections on the many sites included in this tour. Tour was well organized and Barnaby's sense of politics and deep understanding off the last days of WWII was much appreciated. I learned so much. I would recommend this tour to anyone visiting Berlin.
A very interesting and entertaining 4-hour walk. We learnt a lot about the last days of the the war and also the background to how the nazis came into power. Taylor was a very good guide.

Besides all the delicious food, this is one of the best thing we experienced in Berlin. We enjoyed that we were able to walk to many of the sites and take public transport a couple times in order to be able to cover a large chunk of the city. The weather was agreeable for this and for a young, active family, it was ideal.
